notes.title: The Lost Recipes is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The wait is finally over, [b]The Lost Recipes is OUT NOW[/b] and can be purchased on Steam. Please note that, if you already own the previous two games, you can save on top of the -20% launch discount by purchasing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24672/Goblin_and_Coins_collection/]complete the set bundle[/url]. 

[b]What awaits you?[/b]

[list]
[*]     Familiar platforming mechanics, traps and enemies, but improved! 
[*]     25 handcrafted levels
[*]     world 1 very easy, worlds 2 and 3 easy/medium, worlds 4-5 a bit challenging  
[*]     Unlimited continues / level restarts 
[*]     No boss fights, just platforming fun!  
[*]     Double-jump available from the very start of the game 
[*]     5 brand new recipes to unlock, prepare (baking), and post your artwork to the game hub 
[*]    English and Serbian language (with Brazilian Portuguese coming soon and more to potentially come later)
[*]   Gamepad support, keyboard re-binding  
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2677680/Goblin_and_Coins_II_The_Lost_Recipes/ 

[i]Please note - if you're using GNU/Linux and your default Proton doesn't work, try switching to version 9.0.2. [/i]

notes.title: The Lost Recipes will release on August 28th
notes.content:
Hello little goblins,
Let's head back into adventuring and numismatics! The Lost Recipes, a much easier stand-alone expansion for the Goblin and Coins II, will release on August 28th on Steam.

[b]What can you expect?[/b]

[list]
[*]         25 handcrafted levels (that get a bit challenging close to the end, but are a walk in the park compared to the most of GnC2 maze-like levels)
[*]         Familiar mechanics, traps and enemies - but improved!
[*]         Unlimited continues / level restarts
[*]         No boss fights, just platforming
[*]         Double-jump available from the very start of the game
[*]         5 brand new recipes to unlock, prepare, and post your artwork to the game hub
[*]         Locked chests, shortcut portals and secret areas 
[*]         Affordable price 
[*]         Doesn't require you to play any previous game 
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2677680/Goblin_and_Coins_II_The_Lost_Recipes/

notes.title: Goblin and Coins II is coming to Steam in April 2023
notes.content:
Goblin and Coins II, a direct sequel to the Goblin and Coins, is planned to release on Steam in April of 2023. The game will feature 25 handcrafted story levels, 5 boss battles, 5 secret/bonus levels and the ability to regain lives/continues when all are lost. The focus is on bringing features gamers requested after enjoying the first game. 

https://youtu.be/u-DVAzLCTy0

Run and jump through a new adventure, explore the world, collect coins, unlock upgrades, revisit levels to find secrets and face enemies old and new. 

[b] What's new? [/b]

[list]
[*] Improved graphics, extended mechanics and simple puzzles 
[*] Create your own difficulty by getting or ignoring the upgrades 
[*] Revisit levels, find secrets, optional easier start for the new players 
[*] No game over - there's a secret way to regain your lost lives... 
[*] It Already supports English, Serbian, Turkish, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian, with more languages coming in the future.  
[/list]

Click here to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/694990/Goblin_and_Coins_II/]follow and wishlist now[/url]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/694990/Goblin_and_Coins_II/

notes.title: Try the Goblin and Coins II DEMO in the NEXT Fest
notes.content:
Goblin and Coins II will participate in the NEXT FEST June '22 with a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/694990/Goblin_and_Coins_II/]DEMO[/url] for you to try out and hopefully have fun. 

[u]What to expect in the DEMO:[/u]
[list]
[*] English and Serbian language only. More to come in the full release. 
[*] Only the Windows build available for now, Linux/SteamDeck dedicated build coming later (you can try and use Proton though, should work perfectly). 
[*] All settings and options available, be sure to tune it to your liking before playing. 
[*] Available levels: Midnight raid, Sunny beach, Fisherman's village, Dark mines, Downhill, Cpt. Greenbeard boss fight, Snowy pass, Ice caves (+ the underground, a special level you only get to see after you lose all lives/continues). These are the initial levels and are on the easy side. 
[*] Quarter of the world map, including store/trader (ingame coins exchanged for upgrades, no mtx!)
[*] Upgrade 2 (double jump) is purchasable for free (available sum will go into debt now, will cost 100 coins later. [i]I recommend getting the 4th life first, so you can have both[/i])
[*] Upgrade 4 (shrinky in a blinky) works automatically without a purchase (will cost 200 coins later, enables using crawlspaces)
[/list]

[b]The Steam NEXT FEST June '22 edition will run from June 13th to 20th, so be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/694990/Goblin_and_Coins_II/]download and try the demo[/url] before the time runs out.[/b]

If you have any comments and want to provide feedback after playing the DEMO you can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/694990/discussions/0/3382779373367445926/]visit the forums and write your thoughts there[/url] (you can also press F1 in game to jump there instantly).

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - Changelog
notes.content:
Added D-input support for Windows. This should enable users with older/generic controllers to use them in the game. 

Please note that buttons might be mapped differently than on x-input controllers and you might have to enable analogue mode (or try other things) in order to use your controller. 

If you encounter any troubles, please [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/551580/discussions/0/282992646985823238/]report in the community forums[/url] and remember to mention what version of the game you are using (for example, 1.0.4. Spanish) and what kind of controller (x-input or d-input).

tags.feature: Added D-input support for Windows. This should enable users with older/generic controllers to use them in the game.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3.1 - Changelog
notes.content:
Fixed a visibility issue with old school difficulty only bean cauldrons in Spanish and Russian version of the game. 

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/551580/announcements/detail/1430306874643901127]Patch 1.0.3[/url] added new bean soup cauldrons to certain levels that were supposed to be visible only in old school difficulty. Due to a minor bug they were visible - but not allowed for picking up - to casual players using Spanish or Russian version of the game. This should be fixed now and these cauldrons will not be visible and will not confuse the players anymore.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Changelog
notes.content:
- Fixed: Magic cast by wizards now respects the invulnerability state
- Changed: New bean soup cauldrons (life/hp) added for old school difficulty

[i]New cauldrons can be found in levels 1-5, 2-3, 2-6, 3-1, 3-4, 3-6, 4-1, 4-5, 4-7, 5-1 and 5-4.[/i]

[b]Please note:[/b]

If you encounter any technical difficulties that were not present in the previous build, or you want the old difficulty setting without additional cauldrons, you might consider downgrading - which is now an option. Just select the game in your Steam client, go to properties then betas tab, then select "downgrade - previous version". 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753431/cfaaf00419088afff1cc785e284c2419ba7259e9.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Spanish and Russian supported now!
notes.content:
Hello goblins,
It's my pleasure to inform you that the game officially supports Russian and Spanish now. If you want to play in a language other than English, simply do this:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753431/1e494860fb664033c1427efcce84a765a802f7a4.png[/img]

Also, there's an additional challenge level for players who already finished the main story (you need to finish the story to unlock access to challenge levels).

[i]Full price too expensive for you? Wishlist the game and be informed whenever it's on sale![/i]
